description: Mauricio Souza de Alencar at the Technical University of Denmark publishes electrical collection-network designs from wind-farm cable-routing experiments. Two compressed SQLite databases contain a literature-model comparison and the wider study cases. The release dated March 2025 is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Version-four databases require optiwindnet 0.2.1 or newer; version-three files contain the same data in an older schema. Official notebooks demonstrate loading and plotting cases including Ormonde, Horns Rev 1, Thanet and Anholt. These generated networks can compare cable-routing and optimisation methods for offshore energy systems. They are experimental designs, not verified as-built cable inventories. Geographic coordinates, electrical assumptions and uncertainty must be checked within the databases. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. Data and notebook execution were not independently tested.
